content.description: Installing thinner snap ring in clutch drum, showing hands compressing snap ring into groove

items.heading: INSTALL THINNER SNAP RING IN CLUTCH DRUM
substeps: (a) Remove the outer snap ring, rear clutch hub and disc to allow installation of the thinner snap ring.
(b) Compress and lower the snap ring into the groove by hand. Check that the ends of the snap ring are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

content.description: Installing disc and inner thrust bearing, showing cross-section view with front direction indicated and inner/outer center markings

items.heading: INSTALL INNER THRUST BEARING AND RACES

content.text: IMPORTANT: Coat parts with petroleum jelly to hold them.

content: Install the inner race, needle bearing and outer race. Press them into place.

content.text: NOTE: Face the lip of race toward the front of the clutch body.

content.description: Installing front clutch hub, showing hub being aligned with clutch drum

items.heading: INSTALL FRONT CLUTCH HUB
items.text: Align the disc lugs with the hub teeth. Make sure the hub meshes with all discs and is fully inserted.

content.description: Installing rear clutch hub and outer snap ring, showing snap ring being installed with cutouts visible

items.heading: INSTALL REAR CLUTCH HUB AND OUTER SNAP RING
items.text: Check that the snap ring ends are not aligned with one of the cutouts.

note.text: NOTE: Note the position of the inner thrust bearing and races, and keep them together until assembly.

items.heading: KEEP THRUST BEARINGS AND RACES TOGETHER
